class.name: TextDataFormat
class.brief_description: Base class of the data file formats [INI], [CSV], [XML], [TOML] and [YAML].

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets [member data] to the empty value of the format, removes the kept text and clears the error. Subclasses also reset their own state, for example the header of a [CSV].

method.name: encode_to_text
method.description: Returns [member data] as text of this format, using [member options]. Prints an error and returns an empty [String] if [member data] does not fit the format. Unlike [method save], it never returns the kept text.

method.name: get_error_column
method.description: Returns the 1-based column of the error of the last call to [method parse] or [method load], or [code]0[/code] if there was no error or the column is unknown. [INI], [CSV] and [XML] always return [code]0[/code]; [TOML] and [YAML] report the column.

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the 1-based line of the error of the last call to [method parse] or [method load], or [code]0[/code] if there was no error.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the error message of the last call to [method parse] or [method load], or an empty [String] if there was no error.

method.name: get_parsed_text
method.description: Returns the text kept by [method parse] with [code]keep_text[/code] set, or an empty [String] if no text is kept. The text is dropped when [member data] changes.

method.name: get_recognized_extensions
method.description: Returns the file extensions of this format, without the dot, for example [code]["yaml", "yml"][/code] for [YAML].

method.name: load
method.description: Reads the file at [param path] and parses it, like [method ConfigFile.load]. The resource cache is not used and [member Resource.resource_path] is not changed. Returns [constant OK], or an error code if the file can't be read or parsed; see [method get_error_message].

method.name: parse
method.description: Parses [param text] with [member options] and stores the result in [member data]. If [param keep_text] is [code]true[/code], the text is kept for [method get_parsed_text] and [method save], also if parsing fails. Returns [constant OK], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] and stores the error for [method get_error_message], [method get_error_line] and [method get_error_column]. After an error, [member data] is the empty value of the format.

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the file at [param path], like [method ConfigFile.save]. If text was kept by [method parse] and [member data] has not changed since, the kept text is written, so comments and formatting survive; otherwise [member data] is written with [member options]. Returns [constant OK] or an error code. In exported games [code]res://[/code] is read-only: save to [code]user://[/code].

method.name: validate

members.member: The parsed content: the type depends on the format ([Dictionary] for [INI], [XML] and [TOML], [Array] of [PackedStringArray] rows for [CSV], any [Variant] for [YAML]). Setting it drops the kept parsed text and clears the error of the last [method parse]. Setting a value of the wrong type for the format prints an error.
The options used by [method parse], [method encode_to_text] and [method save]. [code]null[/code] uses the project settings under [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/[/code].
